data.name: Nashat
data.gender_notes: Nashat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ‘N-S-H’, Nashat means restraint, prevention, or refuge. In the Islamic context, it can be interpreted as having self-control, being righteous, and being a source of guidance and protection. The name Nashat carries the meaning “Restraint, Prevention” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nashat usually hope their child will grow to embody restraint, prevention and live with faith, good character and purpose.
